lessons.title: Just Eat apologises for AI food mistakes after social media ridicule
lessons.title_zh: Just Eat為人工智慧食物錯誤致歉，遭到社群媒體嘲笑

paragraphs.en: The online food delivery platform Just Eat issued an apology after facing online mockery over strange pictures created by artificial intelligence. The company had been testing the computer technology to display dishes that lacked photos. However, the results did not turn out as intended, and the system produced bizarre food combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 線上美食外送平台 Just Eat（Just Eat）在面對人工智慧所產生的奇怪圖片引發網路嘲笑後，發表了道歉聲明。該公司先前一直在測試這項電腦技術，以展示缺乏照片的菜餚。然而，結果並未如預期，系統產生了奇特的食物組合。

paragraphs.en: Instead of normal meals, the software generated unusual dishes, including bacon and eggs floating inside a glass of soda. This happened because the system confused soda with soda bread. Other strange examples involved french fries poking out of muffins, and a cheese roll turning into pieces of cheese shaped like a sushi roll.
paragraphs.zh: 軟體沒有生成正常的餐點，而是產生成了不尋常的菜餚，包括培根和蛋浮在玻璃杯的汽水裡。發生這種情況是因為系統將汽水與蘇打麵包搞混了。其他奇怪的例子還包括薯條從馬芬蛋糕中凸出來，以及起司捲變成了壽司捲形狀的起司塊。

paragraphs.en: A company spokesperson stated that the firm was working to remove the incorrect pictures. The representative also mentioned that they would stop creating new ones until the technology was improved. The spokesperson explained to the BBC that they work with many small restaurants and trial new technology, but it is not always correct initially.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司發言人表示，公司正在努力移除不正確的圖片。這位代表也提到，在技術改進之前，他們將停止製作新的圖片。發言人向英國廣播公司（BBC）解釋說，他們與許多小型餐廳合作並試驗新技術，但它最初並不總是完全正確。

paragraphs.en: This situation shows the challenges that businesses still experience when they use artificial intelligence to simplify work tasks. Users on social media shared these funny mistakes online. Although some people found the pictures amusing, a customer pointed out that realistic images are better because perfect artificial pictures could lead to disappointment.
paragraphs.zh: 這種情況顯示了企業在使用人工智慧來簡化工作任務時仍然面臨的挑戰。社群媒體上的使用者在網路上分享了這些有趣的錯誤。雖然有些人覺得這些圖片很有趣，但一位顧客指出，逼真的圖片更好，因為完美的人工圖片可能會導致失望。

grammar.explain: 用來表示過去某個動作或狀態之前已經完成的動作，結構為「had + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: The company had been testing the computer technology to display dishes that lacked photos.
grammar.focus: had been testing

grammar.explain: 用關係代名詞 which 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的先行詞 dishes。
grammar.example: The company had been testing the computer technology to display dishes that lacked photos.
grammar.focus: that lacked photos

grammar.explain: 用來強調接受動作的對象，結構為「be 動詞 + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: This happened because the system confused soda with soda bread.
grammar.focus: confused

lessons.title: New human data hints at psychedelics' potential to combat inflammation
lessons.title_zh: 人體新資料顯示迷幻藥物具有對抗發炎的潛力

paragraphs.en: For years, scientists studying psychedelics like psilocybin have focused on mental health and how these substances affect the human brain. However, new research shows that these drugs might also help treat physical problems. A recent study suggests that psilocybin has the potential to fight inflammation and restore stressed cells throughout the body.
paragraphs.zh: 多年來，研究西洛西賓等迷幻藥物的科學家一直專注於心理健康，以及這些物質如何影響人類大腦。然而，新的研究顯示，這些藥物可能也有助於治療身體上的疾病。最近的一項研究指出，西洛西賓具有對抗全身發炎反應並修復受壓細胞的潛力。

paragraphs.en: The study, published in the medical journal JAMA Psychiatry, was conducted by a team at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF). Researchers examined twelve participants with Parkinson's disease, an illness marked by chronic inflammation and damaged mitochondria, which are the energy-producing parts of cells. Scientists tested blood samples before and after the patients received two doses of psilocybin.
paragraphs.zh: 這項發表在醫學期刊《JAMA精神病學》（JAMA Psychiatry）上的研究，是由加州大學舊金山分校（UCSF）的一個團隊所進行。研究人員檢視了十二名帕金森氏症患者，該疾病的特徵為慢性發炎以及受損的粒線體，即細胞中產生能量的構造。科學家在病患接受兩劑西洛西賓之前與之後，檢驗了他們的血液樣本。

paragraphs.en: The results showed that participants had significantly lower levels of inflammation after the treatment. In fact, these healthy reductions lasted for an entire month after the final dose. Psilocybin also provided immediate improvements in cellular energy stress. Dr. Ellen Bradley from UCSF noted that the study showed a "really promising safety profile" and that symptoms improved.
paragraphs.zh: 結果顯示，參與者在接受治療後，發炎程度顯著降低。事實上，這些有益的降低情況在最後一劑施用後持續了一整個月。西洛西賓也對細胞能量壓力帶來了立即的改善。來自加州大學舊金山分校的艾倫‧布拉德利（Dr. Ellen Bradley）博士指出，該研究顯示出「極具前景的安全性評估」，且症狀有所改善。

paragraphs.en: Even though the findings are promising, researchers emphasize that the trial had certain limitations. It was a small study without a control group, and the participants knew they were taking the drug. Therefore, co-author Aoife O'Donovan explained that more follow-up trials are needed before drawing firm conclusions.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管這些發現令人期待，研究人員強調這項試驗存在某些局限性。這是一項沒有對照組的小型研究，而且參與者知道自己正在服用該藥物。因此，共同作者奧伊芙‧奧多諾萬（Aoife O'Donovan）解釋說，在得出明確結論之前，還需要進行更多的後續試驗。

paragraphs.en: Outside experts still view the research as an important milestone. Charles Nichols, a professor at LSU Health Sciences Center, discovered the anti-inflammatory effects of psychedelics in laboratory models fifteen years ago. He described this new study as a proof of principle, validating years of animal experiments and opening doors for future human treatments.
paragraphs.zh: 外部專家仍然將這項研究視為一個重要的里程碑。路易斯安那州立大學健康科學中心（LSU Health Sciences Center）的教授查爾斯‧尼可斯（Charles Nichols）在十五年前就在實驗室模型中發現了迷幻藥物的抗發炎效果。他將這項新研究描述為一項概念驗證，驗證了多年來的動物實驗，並為未來的人類治療開啟了大門。

grammar.explain: 由 be 動詞 was 加上過去分詞 conducted 所構成，表示該研究「由……所執行」。
grammar.example: The study, published in the medical journal JAMA Psychiatry, was conducted by a team at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF).
grammar.focus: was conducted by

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Adjective Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: which 作為主詞引導形容詞子句，用來修飾並補充說明先行詞 mitochondria（粒線體）。
grammar.example: Researchers examined twelve participants with Parkinson's disease, an illness marked by chronic inflammation and damaged mitochondria, which are the energy-producing parts of cells.
grammar.focus: which are the energy-producing parts of cells

grammar.point: 介系詞後的動名詞 (Gerund after a Preposition)
grammar.explain: before 在此處作為介系詞使用，後方須接動名詞 drawing 作為受詞。
grammar.example: Therefore, co-author Aoife O'Donovan explained that more follow-up trials are needed before drawing firm conclusions.
grammar.focus: before drawing firm conclusions

lessons.title: Subtropical Storm Josephine forms off Mid-Atlantic coast
lessons.title_zh: 亞熱帶風暴約瑟芬於中大西洋沿岸外海形成

paragraphs.en: Subtropical Storm Josephine has formed off the Mid-Atlantic coast, becoming the tenth named storm of the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season. According to the National Hurricane Center (NHC), the center of the storm is located about 265 miles south of Nantucket, carrying maximum sustained winds of nearly 65 miles per hour. Although the storm continues to churn over the sea, weather experts say it will mainly be an inconvenience rather than a major disaster for nearby coastal communities as it journeys north.
paragraphs.zh: 亞熱帶風暴約瑟芬已在中大西洋沿岸外海形成，成為2026年大西洋颶風季第十個被命名的風暴。根據國家颶風中心（NHC）的說法，該風暴中心位於南塔克特南方約265英里處，持續風速接近每小時65英里。儘管該風暴持續在海面上翻騰，氣象專家表示，當它向北移動時，對鄰近沿海地區而言主要只是一場小麻煩，而非重大災難。

paragraphs.en: This year's hurricane season has been progressing much slower than usual. Typically, the tenth named storm appears by late September, but a powerful El Niño climate pattern has actively suppressed storm formation in the Atlantic Ocean. Forecasts indicate that Josephine will stay far away from the eastern coastline. It is expected to move toward the northeast on Thursday before completely dissipating over the weekend.
paragraphs.zh: 今年的颶風季進展比往常慢得多。通常第十個被命名的風暴會在九月下旬出現，但強烈的聖嬰現象抑制了今年大西洋的風暴活動。氣象預報顯示，約瑟芬將會與東海岸保持相當遠的距離。它預計將於週四朝東北方移動，然後在週末完全消散。

paragraphs.en: Subtropical storms possess a combination of features from both tropical and non-tropical weather systems. For instance, they absorb energy from warm ocean waters, but they also display characteristics common to classic nor'easters. Even though meteorologists classify them differently, this distinction makes little difference regarding their potential impact, as subtropical systems can still unleash dangerous winds, heavy rainfall, and coastal flooding.
paragraphs.zh: 亞熱帶風暴兼具熱帶與非熱帶天氣系統的特徵。例如，它們從溫暖的海洋表面汲取能量，但也展現出傳統東北風暴常見的特點。儘管氣象學家對它們進行不同的分類，但這種區別在潛在衝擊方面幾乎沒有差別，因為亞熱帶系統依然能帶來危險的強風、暴雨以及沿海淹水。

paragraphs.en: Josephine is forecast to gain some strength over the next 36 hours and produce hurricane-force winds by late Thursday when it turns into a post-tropical storm. Fortunately, most of the severe rain and powerful winds will remain over the open Atlantic. However, breezy conditions will still affect sections of the East Coast through Thursday, especially Cape Cod, Massachusetts. Furthermore, minor coastal flooding could occur during high tide from the Mid-Atlantic to Cape Cod through Friday, though inland areas will remain mostly dry.
paragraphs.zh: 約瑟芬預計在接下來的36小時內還會有所增強，並在週四晚間轉變成後熱帶風暴時帶來颶風級強風。幸運的是，大部分的劇烈降雨和強勁風力將留在開闊的大西洋海面上。然而，有風的天氣仍會在週四前影響東海岸的部分區域，特別是麻薩諸塞州的鱈魚角。此外，從中大西洋到鱈魚角一帶，在週五前的高潮期間可能會發生沿海淹水，不過內陸大部分地區將保持乾燥。

phrases.zh: 幾乎沒有差別；影響不大

grammar.explain: 逗號後方使用現在分詞短語補充說明主句動作發生的結果。
grammar.example: Subtropical Storm Josephine has formed off the Mid-Atlantic coast, becoming the tenth named storm of the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season.
grammar.focus: becoming the tenth named storm

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞 Although 引導讓步子句，表示「雖然……」，與主要子句形成語氣上的對比。
grammar.example: Although the storm continues to churn over the sea, weather experts say it will mainly be an inconvenience rather than a major disaster for nearby coastal communities as it journeys north.
grammar.focus: Although the storm continues to churn over the sea

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 that 引導的名詞子句，在句中充當及物動詞 indicate 的受詞。
grammar.example: Forecasts indicate that Josephine will stay far away from the eastern coastline.
grammar.focus: that Josephine will stay far away from the eastern coastline

lessons.title: Ebola has spread from Congo to 4 other countries. A look at where things stand
lessons.title_zh: 伊波拉已從剛果蔓延至其他4國：各國最新現況一覽

paragraphs.en: A dangerous Ebola outbreak that began in eastern Congo in mid-May has spread to four other nations, making it active in two of them. Reaching the central, western, and eastern parts of Africa, it has traveled farther across the continent than any earlier outbreak. The World Health Organization (WHO) stated that this is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history. It is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, which currently lacks an approved vaccine or medicine. In Congo alone, at least 4,600 of the 9,500 infected people have died.
paragraphs.zh: 一場於五月中旬在剛果東部爆發的危險伊波拉疫情已蔓延至其他四個國家，並在其中兩個國家仍處於活躍狀態。該疫情擴散至非洲的中部、西部與東部地區，在非洲大陸上傳播的範圍比以往任何一次伊波拉疫情都還要廣。世界衛生組織（WHO）表示，這是史上增長最迅速的伊波拉疫情。它是由罕見的本迪布焦病毒（Bundibugyo virus）所引起，目前該病毒尚無獲得核准的疫苗或藥物。光是在剛果，9,500名感染者中就至少有4,600人死亡。

paragraphs.en: Experts note that weak health monitoring has allowed the disease to cross borders, as many patients were diagnosed only after traveling or falling ill. Nigeria recently became the newest country to report an infection. A woman arrived in the capital city of Abuja from Uganda and developed symptoms on October 7. She entered a private hospital on October 11 and was later diagnosed. Nigeria's Health Minister Muhammad Pate stated that officials were "doing everything possible to contain this case" while tracking 44 close contacts.
paragraphs.zh: 專家指出，鬆散的健康監測讓這種疾病跨越了國界，因為許多病患都是在旅行或發病很久之後才被確診。奈及利亞最近成為最新通報感染病例的國家。一名女子從烏干達抵達首都阿布加，並於10月7日出現症狀。她於10月11日住進阿布加的一家私立醫院，隨後被診斷出感染伊波拉。奈及利亞衛生部長穆罕默德·帕特（Muhammad Pate）表示，官員們正在「竭盡所能控制此病例」，同時追蹤44名密切接觸者。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, neighboring Uganda has already managed to stop its outbreak. Uganda confirmed its first case on the same day as Congo when an infected traveler crossed the border. Later, Congolese patients seeking medical care for an unidentified sickness brought more infections. However, the WHO declared Uganda's outbreak over on August 27 after recording 20 cases and two deaths, with 18 recoveries and over 800 contacts monitored. The nation recently confirmed that there are no new cases.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，鄰國烏干達已經成功遏制了當地的疫情。當一名受感染的旅客越過邊界時，烏干達在與剛果同一天確認了首宗病例。隨後，為不明疾病尋求治療的剛果病患帶來了更多感染。然而，在記錄了20起病例、兩起死亡、18人康復並監測了800多名接觸者後，世界衛生組織於8月27日宣布烏干達的疫情結束。該國最近證實目前沒有新增病例。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, Kenya is currently dealing with rising infections. A man who traveled from Congo through Uganda reached Nairobi on October 3. He tested positive on October 5 and died that same day. Cases in Kenya have now reached nine, including four family members and four healthcare workers. Authorities have traced 135 contacts, placing 134 in quarantine. Fortunately, health officials have found no sign of the virus spreading beyond these known individuals. Outside Africa, France reported one case in June involving a doctor who returned from Congo, but that patient recovered and left the hospital in July.
paragraphs.zh: 相比之下，肯亞目前正在應對不斷增加的感染情況。一名從剛果經由烏干達旅行的男子於10月3日抵達奈洛比。他於10月5日篩檢呈陽性，並於當天身亡。肯亞的病例現已增至九起，包括首名病患的四名親屬和四名醫護人員。當局已追蹤了135名接觸者，並將其中134人進行隔離。幸運的是，衛生官員尚未發現病毒在這些已知人士之外傳播的跡象。在非洲以外地區，法國於六月通報了一起病例，涉及一名從剛果返回的醫師，但該病患已康復並於七月出院。

grammar.explain: 由「has/have + 過去分詞」構成，在此表示自過去某時點開始並持續影響到現在的動作或狀態。
grammar.example: A dangerous Ebola outbreak that began in eastern Congo in mid-May has spread to four other nations, making it active in two of them.
grammar.focus: has spread

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的非限定子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 先行詞後加上逗號，由關係代名詞「which」引導子句，提供先行詞的補充說明。
grammar.example: It is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, which currently lacks an approved vaccine or medicine.
grammar.focus: which currently lacks an approved vaccine or medicine

grammar.point: 分詞構句表伴隨或結果 (Participle Construction Expressing Result)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞「placing」，修飾前述的主要子句，表達隨之產生的動作或結果。
grammar.example: Authorities have traced 135 contacts, placing 134 in quarantine.
grammar.focus: placing 134 in quarantine

lessons.title: The iPhone Duo is Apple’s coolest phone in years. There’s just one problem
lessons.title_zh: iPhone雙螢幕版是蘋果多年來最酷的手機。這裡只有一個問題

paragraphs.en: Apple has introduced its very first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, which went on sale on October 23 with a starting price of two thousand US dollars. This device represents the biggest design change for the company in nearly twenty years, costing as much as the latest fourteen-inch MacBook Pro. The product features a five-point-four-inch screen on the outside that opens up to reveal a seven-point-six-inch display on the inside.
paragraphs.zh: 蘋果推出了它的第一款可摺疊智慧型手機 iPhone Duo，該手機於 10 月 23 日上市，起售價為 2,000 美元。這款裝置代表了該公司近 20 年來最大的設計改變，其價格與最新的 14 吋 MacBook Pro 一樣昂貴。該產品外部配備一個 5.4 吋的螢幕，展開後可展現出一個 7.6 吋的內部顯示器。

paragraphs.en: During a testing period provided by the company, a reviewer found that the device could function as a tablet, an extra screen, a bedside clock, and a camera stand. When closed, it feels similar to a passport but thicker, and when opened, it resembles a smaller iPad Mini. Users can even run two applications at the same time, making multitasking much easier than before.
paragraphs.zh: 在該公司提供的一段測試期間內，一位評論者發現該裝置可以充當平板電腦、額外螢幕、床頭時鐘和相機支架。當它關閉時，感覺類似於護照但更厚，而當它打開時，則類似於較小的 iPad Mini。使用者甚至可以同時執行兩個應用程式，使多工處理比以前容易得多。

paragraphs.en: However, many popular programs have not been updated for the large screen yet, leading to some frustration. While some software programs expand to fit more space, others still leave black bars along the sides because developers have not used the latest software tools. This lack of consistency makes the user experience feel a bit uncertain and jarring compared to Android alternatives that have offered similar features for years.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，許多熱門程式尚未針對大螢幕進行更新，導致了一些挫折感。雖然有些軟體程式會擴展以適應更多的空間，但其他程式由於開發人員尚未使用最新的軟體工具，仍然在側邊留有黑邊。與多年來一直提供類似功能的 Android 替代品相比，這種缺乏一致性的情況使得使用者體驗感到有些不確定且突兀。

paragraphs.en: Despite these software issues, the hardware design has several advantages, such as a matte finish that reduces glare and a crease that is barely visible during use. Typing on the cover screen also feels surprisingly natural and comfortable for daily tasks. Battery life remains reasonable and meets general expectations, though it depends heavily on how often the inner tablet display is used.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管存在這些軟體問題，但硬體設計具有多個優點，例如能減少眩光的霧面塗層，以及在使用過程中幾乎看不見的摺痕。在封面螢幕上打字對於日常任務來說也感覺出奇地自然和舒適。電池續航力保持合理並符合一般預期，儘管這很大程度上取決於內部平板顯示器的使用頻率。

paragraphs.en: Because the device is very expensive and many apps still need optimization, experts suggest waiting before making a purchase. The reviewer advises consumers to hold off until developers finish updating their programs, ensuring the device can fully deliver on its high price tag.
paragraphs.zh: 由於該裝置非常昂貴且許多應用程式仍需要優化，專家建議在購買前先等一下。該評論者建議消費者先觀望，直到開發人員完成其程式的更新，以確保該裝置能夠完全對得起它高昂的價格標籤。

grammar.explain: 說明先行詞 a foldable smartphone，用 which 引導形容詞子句補充說明。
grammar.example: Apple has introduced its very first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, which went on sale on October 23 with a starting price of two thousand US dollars.
grammar.focus: which went on sale on October 23 with a starting price of two thousand US dollars

grammar.explain: 強調動作的承受者，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞 updated。
grammar.example: While some software programs expand to fit more space, others still leave black bars along the sides because developers have not used the latest software tools.
grammar.focus: have not used

lessons.title: A Netflix reality show evokes one of history’s most controversial scientific experiments — and the man behind it
lessons.title_zh: Netflix實景秀喚起歷史上最具爭議的科學實驗之一及其背後的人物

paragraphs.en: A new Netflix series has brought the Stanford Prison Experiment back into the public eye. Organized in 1971 by psychologist Philip Zimbardo, the study placed male college students into mock prison roles as guards and prisoners in a university basement. Zimbardo wanted to discover if normal people would commit cruel acts simply because of their environment and orders.
paragraphs.zh: 一部新的Netflix影集將史丹佛監獄實驗重新帶回大眾的視野。這項研究由心理學家菲利普·辛巴達於1971年組織，將男大學生安排在大學地下室中扮演警衛和囚犯的模擬監獄角色。辛巴達想要發現正常人是否會僅僅因為他們的環境和命令而做出殘酷的行為。

paragraphs.en: However, the two-week study quickly fell apart. Within days, prisoners rebelled, and guards used aggressive tactics to repress them while real-world prison unrest was happening globally. Although the project made Zimbardo famous, experts later questioned its methods and ethics. Evidence showed that Zimbardo directly influenced the outcome by coaching the guards and preventing inmates from leaving.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，這項為期兩週的研究很快就瓦解了。幾天之內，囚犯們就進行了反抗，而當全球各地正在發生現實世界的監獄動亂時，警衛們則使用激進的策略來壓制他們。儘管這個計畫讓辛巴達聲名大噪，但專家後來質疑其方法和倫理。證據表明，辛巴達透過指導警衛並阻止囚犯離開直接影響了結果。

paragraphs.en: This controversy reflects a broader crisis within psychological research regarding the reliability of study results. A later attempt to replicate similar social experiments by the BBC in 2002 produced completely different outcomes. Unlike the Stanford study, the guards in the television project did not become tyrannical because there was no authoritative figure directing their behavior, leading the participants to form a shared community instead.
paragraphs.zh: 這場爭議反映了心理學研究內部關於研究結果可靠性的更廣泛危機。英國廣播公司在2002年隨後試圖複製類似的社會實驗，產生了完全不同的結果。與史丹佛的研究不同，電視計畫中的警衛並沒有變得暴虐，因為沒有權威人物指導他們的行為，這導致參與者反而形成了一個共享的社群。

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語當形容詞 (Past participle phrase as adjective)
grammar.explain: 用過去分詞片語放在名詞後面，用來修飾該名詞並表達被動關係。
grammar.example: Organized in 1971 by psychologist Philip Zimbardo, the study placed male college students into mock prison roles as guards and prisoners in a university basement.
grammar.focus: Organized in 1971 by psychologist Philip Zimbardo

grammar.point: 副詞子句表原因 (Adverbial clause of reason)
grammar.explain: 使用because引導副詞子句，用來補充說明主句動作發生的原因。
grammar.example: Unlike the Stanford study, the guards in the television project did not become tyrannical because there was no authoritative figure directing their behavior, leading the participants to form a shared community instead.
grammar.focus: because there was no authoritative figure directing their behavior

grammar.point: 現在分詞構句 (Present participle clause)
grammar.explain: 使用逗號連接V-ing分詞片語，表達伴隨發生的結果或情況。
grammar.example: Unlike the Stanford study, the guards in the television project did not become tyrannical because there was no authoritative figure directing their behavior, leading the participants to form a shared community instead.
grammar.focus: leading the participants to form a shared community instead

lessons.title: Astonishing winning images from Nikon’s Small World photography competition 2026
lessons.title_zh: 尼康 2026 年微觀世界攝影比賽令人驚嘆的得獎影像

paragraphs.en: A fascinating photograph capturing tiny ink droplets inside a printing device has secured the top prize at the annual Nikon Small World photomicrography event. This competition places its main focus on remarkable pictures created through specialized microscope lenses.
paragraphs.zh: 一張捕捉列印裝置內部微小墨水液滴的迷人照片，在一年一度的尼康微觀世界顯微攝影活動中奪得首獎。這項競賽將其主要焦點放在透過專業顯微鏡鏡頭所創造的卓越圖片上。

paragraphs.en: The winning picture was captured by Ole Bielfeldt, who studies and practices experimental photography in Germany. He constructed his own custom imaging device to shoot the photo, as shared in an official statement released by event coordinators on Wednesday.
paragraphs.zh: 這張得獎照片是由奧利·比爾費爾特所拍攝，他在德國學習並實踐實驗攝影。根據活動協調員於週三發布的官方聲明所述，他建造了自己的客製化成像裝置來拍攝該照片。

paragraphs.en: Bielfeldt mentioned that he felt deeply curious about how inkjet printers manage to transfer images onto sheets of paper with such high accuracy. He stated in the release that he used to think the process was like magic before he figured out how it truly functioned.
paragraphs.zh: 比爾費爾特提到，他對噴墨印表機如何設法以如此高的準確度將影像轉移到紙張上感到深深的好奇。他在聲明中表示，在弄清楚其實際運作方式之前，他曾認為這個過程就像是魔法一樣。

paragraphs.en: Eric Flem, a representative for the sponsoring organization, pointed out that the winning work truly represents the strength of the event. Flem explained that the creator turned a common item into something completely new by utilizing microscope equipment in an unexpected way.
paragraphs.zh: 贊助組織的代表埃里克·弗萊姆指出，這件得獎作品真正代表了該活動的力量。弗萊姆解釋說，創作者透過以意想不到的方式使用顯微鏡設備，將一個常見的物品變成了一個全新之物。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the first-place winner, other exceptional scientific images also received recognition. John-Oliver Dum earned the second-position award for capturing a jumping spider carrying pollen, while the third spot went to Kaelin Wulf and Rachel Flannery for imaging brain cells inside an enlarged mouse brain.
paragraphs.zh: 除了第一名的得獎者之外，其他傑出的科學影像也獲得了肯定。約翰-奧利弗·杜姆因拍攝一隻攜帶花粉的跳蛛而贏得第二名，而第三名則由凱琳·伍夫和雷切爾·弗蘭納里獲得，其作品是拍攝擴大小鼠腦部內部的大腦細胞。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the organization also hosts a related video contest which faced a major issue recently. The original winner of this moving-image event was disqualified after organizers determined that his use of artificial intelligence tools violated competition regulations.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，該組織也主辦了一項相關的影片競賽，該競賽近期面臨了一個重大問題。這項動態影像活動的原來得獎者在主辦單位認定其使用人工智慧工具違反了競賽規則後遭到取消資格。

grammar.explain: 用 wh- 詞引導子句來修飾前面的先行詞。
grammar.example: A fascinating photograph capturing tiny ink droplets inside a printing device has secured the top prize at the annual Nikon Small World photomicrography event.
grammar.focus: capturing tiny ink droplets inside a printing device

grammar.explain: 表示主體承受動作，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: The winning picture was captured by Ole Bielfeldt, who studies and practices experimental photography in Germany.
grammar.focus: was captured

grammar.point: 副詞子句表原因 (Adverbial Clause of Cause)
grammar.explain: 使用連接詞說明動作發生的原因。
grammar.example: The original winner of this moving-image event was disqualified after organizers determined that his use of artificial intelligence tools violated competition regulations.
grammar.focus: after organizers determined that his use of artificial intelligence tools violated competition regulations

lessons.title: Trump welcomes Britain’s decision to approve new North Sea gas field
lessons.title_zh: 川普對英國決定批准新的北海天然氣田表示歡迎

paragraphs.en: US President Donald Trump recently expressed strong support for the British government regarding a major energy project in the North Sea. The decision allows the development of a new gas field that could begin supplying gas to the public very soon. This move happens while global energy security faces severe challenges because of the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.
paragraphs.zh: 美國總統川普最近對英國政府在北海的一項重大能源計畫表示強烈支持。這項決定允許開發一個新的天然氣田，該氣田可能很快就會開始向大眾供應天然氣。此舉發生在由於中東持續衝突導致全球能源安全面臨嚴重挑戰之際。

paragraphs.en: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham defended the choice by calling it a pragmatic approach, though green groups strongly criticized its potential climate damage. Meanwhile, a fresh United Nations climate report points out that the world will soon exceed the warming limits set by the Paris Climate Agreement, highlighting how fast climate risks are growing.
paragraphs.zh: 英國首相安迪·伯恩ham為這項選擇進行辯護，稱其為務實的做法，儘管環保團體強烈批評其潛在的氣候破壞。同時，一份最新的聯合國氣候報告指出，世界很快就會超過巴黎氣候協定設定的暖化限制，凸顯出氣候風險增長的速度有多快。

paragraphs.en: The government explained that approving the Jackdaw gas field matches its legal promise to reach net zero emissions by the middle of this decade. Officials noted that the project will temporarily raise domestic gas production, safeguard many jobs, and generate billions of pounds for the national economy. Furthermore, the administration plans to set up an Energy Wealth Fund using tax money from these resources to invest in cleaner energy projects.
paragraphs.zh: 政府解釋說，批准傑克多（Jackdaw）天然氣田符合其在本十年中期實現淨零排放的法律承諾。官員指出，該專案將暫時提高國內天然氣產量，保障許多就業機會，併為國民經濟創造數十億英鎊。此外，政府計劃利用這些資源的稅收建立一個能源財富基金，投資於更清潔的能源專案。

paragraphs.en: However, industry experts point out that more local production will not magically lower consumer energy bills or stop the nation from relying on imports. Energy analysts believe that domestic companies will simply sell at European market rates instead of offering cheap discounts. At the same time, major trade unions welcomed the news because it protects workers and secures employment during the industrial transition.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，產業專家指出，更多的本地生產並不會神奇地降低消費者的能源帳單或阻止國家依賴進口。能源分析師認為，國內公司只會以歐洲市場的價格銷售，而不會提供便宜的折扣。與此同時，主要工會對這一訊息表示歡迎，因為它在產業轉型期間保護了工人並確保了就業。

paragraphs.en: As officials consider future approvals for other oilfields, environmental campaigners continue to issue warnings. Groups like Uplift argue that adding new fossil fuel projects is completely unsafe and irresponsible given the severe weather events happening around the world today.
paragraphs.zh: 正當官員們考慮未來對其他油田的批准時，環保人士繼續發出警告。像烏普利夫（Uplift）這樣的團體認為，鑑於當今世界各地發生的嚴重氣候事件，增加新的化石燃料專案是完全不安全且不負責任的。

grammar.explain: 用關代which引導形容詞子句，修飾前面的先行詞the warming limits。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, a fresh United Nations climate report points out that the world will soon exceed the warming limits set by the Paris Climate Agreement, highlighting how fast climate risks are growing.
grammar.focus: that the world will soon exceed

grammar.explain: 用to V表達做某事的目的，說明設立能源財富基金的原因。
grammar.example: Furthermore, the administration plans to set up an Energy Wealth Fund using tax money from these resources to invest in cleaner energy projects.
grammar.focus: to invest in cleaner energy projects

grammar.explain: 用現在分詞V-ing表附帶狀況或結果，補充說明前句所產生的影響。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, a fresh United Nations climate report points out that the world will soon exceed the warming limits set by the Paris Climate Agreement, highlighting how fast climate risks are growing.
grammar.focus: highlighting how fast climate risks are growing

lessons.title: How much does pregnancy cost? Be prepared with these tips
lessons.title_zh: 懷孕成本多少？利用這些實用建議做好準備

paragraphs.en: Many parents find themselves deeply worried about looming medical bills when welcoming a new baby. Grace Griffin and her husband Daniel, both twenty-six years old, knew money would be tight before they tried to conceive their first child. They attempted to calculate the expected costs early on, but finding accurate price estimates proved surprisingly difficult. Insurance cost estimators often required specific billing codes that prospective parents simply did not possess.
paragraphs.zh: 許多父母在迎接新生兒時，發現自己對逼近的醫療帳單感到深深擔憂。葛瑞絲·葛瑞芬（Grace Griffin）與她的丈夫丹尼爾（Daniel）兩人都是二十六歲，在嘗試懷孕生第一個孩子之前，就知道資金會很緊繃。他們試圖在早期計算預期費用，但要找到準確的價格估算卻出奇地困難。保險費用估算工具通常需要準父母根本沒有的特定帳單代碼。

paragraphs.en: After searching through health plan documents, Grace discovered that out-of-pocket costs for a routine pregnancy and delivery were estimated at around two thousand seven hundred dollars. However, real expenses piled up much faster than expected. Early in the pregnancy, Grace reached her five-hundred-dollar deductible, which is the amount she had to pay before her insurance coverage began. Her plan also required twenty percent coinsurance for in-network care, meaning she had to pay twenty dollars for every one hundred dollars billed for routine blood work and other necessary services.
paragraphs.zh: 在翻閱健康計畫文件後，葛瑞絲發現例行懷孕與分娩的自付費用估計約為兩千七百美元。然而，實際開銷累積的速度比預期快得多。懷孕初期，葛瑞絲達到了五百美元的自負額，這是她在保險給付開始前必須支付的金額。她的計畫還要求針對網內醫療提供百分之二十的共付額，這意味著針對例行抽血與其他必要服務每被收取一百美元，她就必須支付二十美元。

paragraphs.en: By October, Grace and Daniel faced out-of-pocket expenses totaling more than nine thousand dollars, which was over three times the general estimate provided by their insurer. Experts note that federal lawmakers have tried to address this transparency issue for years. A rule from the twenty-twenty No Surprises Act aimed to require advanced explanations of benefits, but federal regulators have yet to make it happen. Additionally, upcoming changes to maternity billing codes in twenty-twenty-seven might alter how services are categorized, though experts remain unsure whether patients will actually benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 到了十月，葛瑞絲和丹尼爾面臨的自付費用總計超過九千美元，這超過了保險公司提供的普遍估計的三倍。專家指出，聯邦議員多年來一直試圖解決這個透明度問題。二〇二〇年《無驚喜法案》（No Surprises Act）中的一項規則旨在要求提供預先的給付說明，但聯邦監管機構尚未實現這一點。此外，二〇二七年母嬰帳單代碼即將到變更，可能會改變服務分類的方式，儘管專家對於患者是否能真正受益仍持不確定態度。

paragraphs.en: To help families budget effectively, experts offer several important suggestions. First, parents must act quickly to add a newborn to their health insurance, as many plans enforce a strict thirty-day or sixty-day enrollment window following birth. Missing this deadline can leave a baby uninsured. Furthermore, understanding key terms like deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and maximum out-of-pocket limits helps consumers prepare for worst-case scenarios. Finally, patients should carefully verify that every doctor and facility on their care team participates in their insurance network to avoid unexpected bills.
paragraphs.zh: 為了幫助家庭有效編列預算，專家提出了幾個重要建議。首先，父母必須迅速行動將新生兒加入健保，因為許多計畫在出生後強制執行嚴格的三十天或六十天登記期限。錯過這個期限可能會讓嬰兒沒有保險。此外，理解諸如自負額、定額掛號費、共付額以及最高自付額限制等關鍵詞彙，有助於消費者為最壞情況做好準備。最後，患者應仔細核實其照顧團隊中的每位醫師與設施都加入保險網路，以避免收到意外帳單。

grammar.explain: 用來引導形容詞子句，修飾前面的名詞，這裡用來補充說明 deductible 的定義。
grammar.example: Early in the pregnancy, Grace reached her five-hundred-dollar deductible, which is the amount she had to pay before her insurance coverage began.
grammar.focus: which is the amount she had to pay before her insurance coverage began

grammar.explain: 強調動作的承受者，句型為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: Furthermore, understanding key terms like deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and maximum out-of-pocket limits helps consumers prepare for worst-case scenarios.
grammar.focus: helps consumers prepare

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用 to 加原形動詞來表達做某個動作的目的（即「為了……」）。
grammar.example: To help families budget effectively, experts offer several important suggestions.
grammar.focus: To help families budget effectively

lessons.title: Actor Christina Applegate says she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
lessons.title_zh: 演員克莉絲汀·艾柏蓋特表示她被誤診患有多發性硬化症

paragraphs.en: Actor Christina Applegate recently shared that she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis, a serious condition she believed she had for five years. This medical error caused her to step back from her acting career.
paragraphs.zh: 演員克莉絲汀·艾柏蓋特最近分享她被誤診患有多發性硬化症，這是一個她認為自己得了五年的嚴重疾病。這個醫療錯誤導致她從演藝生涯中退下來。

paragraphs.en: Multiple sclerosis, known as MS, is a chronic neurological disorder where the body's immune system attacks the protective covering of nerve fibers. Such damage can lead to symptoms like severe headaches, tiredness, vision problems, and issues with physical movement.
paragraphs.zh: 多發性硬化症，簡稱 MS，是一種慢性的神經系統疾病，身體的免疫系統會攻擊神經纖維的保護層。這樣的損害會導致嚴重頭痛、疲勞、視力問題以及身體行動困難等症狀。

paragraphs.en: To understand how this could happen, a neurological expert from Johns Hopkins University, Dr. Michael Kornberg, explained that there is no single test to confirm the disease. Instead, doctors must look at a combination of typical symptoms and specific brain scans.
paragraphs.zh: 為了瞭解這怎麼可能發生，來自約翰霍普金斯大學的神經學專家麥可·科恩伯格醫師解釋說，並沒有單一的檢測來確診這種疾病。相反地，醫生必須綜合考量典型症狀與特定的腦部掃描。

paragraphs.en: The specialist noted that other common health issues, such as migraines and vascular diseases, can create similar brain scan results. These overlapping signs often lead to incorrect diagnoses in certain cases.
paragraphs.zh: 這位專家指出，其他常見的健康問題，例如偏頭痛和血管疾病，可能會產生類似的腦部掃描結果。這些重疊的徵兆在某些情況下經常導致錯誤的診斷。

paragraphs.en: Although Applegate feels frustrated and as if she is back at square one because her original answer was taken away, her doctors are continuing to explore other possibilities. They are currently looking into a differential diagnosis to find the true cause of her health struggles.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然艾柏蓋特感到沮喪，且覺得像是回到原點，因為她原本得到的答案被拿掉了，但她的醫師們正持續探索其他可能性。他們目前正在研究鑑別診斷，以找出她健康困擾的真正原因。

grammar.explain: 此處使用關代 where 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的先行詞 a chronic neurological disorder。
grammar.example: Multiple sclerosis, known as MS, is a chronic neurological disorder where the body's immune system attacks the protective covering of nerve fibers.
grammar.focus: where the body's immune system attacks the protective covering of nerve fibers

grammar.explain: 此句使用「be 動詞 + 過去分詞 (was misdiagnosed)」構成被動語態，強調主詞受到的動作。
grammar.example: Actor Christina Applegate recently shared that she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis, a serious condition she believed she had for five years.
grammar.focus: was misdiagnosed

grammar.point: 表目的之不定詞片語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 此處使用 to 不定詞片語來表達採取某個動作的目的（為了理解這怎麼可能發生）。
grammar.example: To understand how this could happen, a neurological expert from Johns Hopkins University, Dr. Michael Kornberg, explained that there is no single test to confirm the disease.
grammar.focus: To understand how this could happen

lessons.title: An AI chatbot files for bankruptcy. Is it a bad omen for the industry?
lessons.title_zh: 人工智慧聊天機器人聲請破產。這對該產業來說是個壞兆頭嗎？

paragraphs.en: Character.AI, a prominent artificial intelligence (AI) company known for its custom role-playing application, has recently filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy. The platform allows users to create virtual companions for conversation and storytelling, attracting millions of regular participants who spend hours on the service daily.
paragraphs.zh: 以客製化角色扮演應用程式聞名的知名人工智慧（AI）公司 Character.AI，最近已聲請第 11 章破產。該平台允許使用者建立虛擬同伴來進行對話與講故事，吸引了數百萬名每天在該服務上花費數小時的固定參與者。

paragraphs.en: Despite having around 12 million monthly active users, the company struggled financially and failed to cover its operating costs over five years. Furthermore, the business faced severe legal challenges, including lawsuits related to safety issues and the unpredictable nature of AI models. Experts note that such legal risks represent a major concern for the entire industry.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管擁有約 1200 萬名每月活躍使用者，該公司在財務上仍舊掙扎，五年來未能涵蓋其營運成本。此外，該企業面臨嚴峻的法律挑戰，包括與安全問題及 AI 模型不可預測性相關的訴訟。專家指出，此類法律風險對整個產業而言是一大隱憂。

paragraphs.en: Another major factor behind the company's downfall was the overheated labor market for expert talent. Major technology firms often offer massive amounts of money to hire top researchers, and competitors eventually recruited the startup's founders and key researchers, leaving very little economic value behind.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司垮臺背後的另一個主要因素是過熱的專業人才就業市場。大型科技企業經常提供巨額資金來雇用頂尖研究人員，而競爭對手最終招募了這家新創公司的創辦人與核心研究人員，留下極少的經濟價值。

paragraphs.en: Some analysts compare this high-profile financial failure to the historical dot-com bust, pointing out that excessive funding and narrow business models can lead to serious trouble. As more legal troubles and market pressures emerge, industry observers wonder what lies ahead for other technology firms.
paragraphs.zh: 有些分析師將這次備受矚目的財務失敗與歷史上的達康泡沫破裂相提並論，指出過多的資金與狹隘的商業模式可能會導致嚴重的麻煩。隨著更多法律麻煩與市場壓力浮現，產業觀察家們紛紛好奇其他科技企業的前景如何。

grammar.explain: 本句使用現在分詞片語作為補充說明，表示伴隨的情況。
grammar.example: Character.AI, a prominent artificial intelligence (AI) company known for its custom role-playing application, has recently filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
grammar.focus: known for its custom role-playing application

grammar.explain: 本句使用關係代名詞子句來修飾先行詞 participants，補充說明其特徵。
grammar.example: The platform allows users to create virtual companions for conversation and storytelling, attracting millions of regular participants who spend hours on the service daily.
grammar.focus: who spend hours on the service daily

grammar.point: 不定詞作副詞用表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 本句使用不定詞片語來表達採取某個動作的目的。
grammar.example: Major technology firms often offer massive amounts of money to hire top researchers, and competitors eventually recruited the startup's founders and key researchers, leaving very little economic value behind.
grammar.focus: to hire top researchers

lessons.title: Influencers are helping 'free birth' gain fans, despite medical risks
lessons.title_zh: 網紅助長「無醫療協助生產」風潮，儘管潛藏醫療風險

paragraphs.en: A controversial trend known as free birth is gaining attention through social media influencers. This practice involves women giving birth at home without the help of a midwife or any medical assistance.
paragraphs.zh: 一項被稱為無醫療協助生產（free birth）的爭議性趨勢正透過社群媒體網紅受到關注。這項做法指的是女性在沒有助產士或任何醫療協助的情況下於家中生產。

paragraphs.en: Natalie Krueger, a mother in Nebraska, chose to have her last two children at home without a doctor or nurse. She previously had a smooth hospital birth with her first child, but she felt uncomfortable there and faced pressure to receive an epidural. Because local laws make it difficult for midwives to attend home births, she decided to plan an unassisted birth with her husband.
paragraphs.zh: 內布拉斯加州的一位母親娜塔莉·克魯格（Natalie Krueger）選擇在家中生下最後兩個孩子，沒有醫師或護士在場。她第一胎在醫院生產過程順利，但她在那裡感到不舒服，且面臨注射無痛分娩（硬脊膜外麻醉）的壓力。由於當地法律讓助產士難以出席居家生產，她決定與丈夫計畫一場無醫療協助的生產。

paragraphs.en: During her recent home birth, her baby's umbilical cord was wrapped around the neck, a dangerous situation they had prepared to handle. However, medical experts warn that childbirth can be completely unpredictable. Dr. Caitlin Linscheid, an OB-GYN in the Kansas City area, explains that obstetric emergencies can happen very quickly and require immediate intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 在她最近的一次居家生產中，她孩子的臍帶繞頸，這是他們先前已準備好應付的危險狀況。然而，醫學專家警告說，分娩可能完全無法預測。堪薩斯城地區的婦產科醫師凱特琳·林舍id（Dr. Caitlin Linscheid）解釋說，產科急症可能會非常迅速地發生，並且需要立即介入。

paragraphs.en: Common childbirth emergencies include fetal distress, postpartum hemorrhage, and a baby's shoulder getting stuck behind the mother's pubic bone. Without a trained professional to intervene, these situations can quickly become life-threatening. Doctors also note that hospitals need to build better trust with patients, as many women choose free birth after feeling ignored during past hospital labors.
paragraphs.zh: 常見的產科急症包括胎兒窘迫、產後大出血，以及嬰兒的肩膀卡在母親恥骨後方。如果沒有受過訓練的專業人員介入，這些情況可能會迅速變成危及生命的狀況。醫師們也指出，醫院需要與患者建立更好的信任關係，因為許多女性在過去的醫院分娩過程中感到被忽略後，才選擇了無醫療協助生產。

paragraphs.en: Official data shows that home births across the country nearly tripled between 2004 and 2024. A medical anthropologist and former midwife named Melissa Cheyney notes that more people are choosing unassisted births after watching online promotions. Meanwhile, Chale Turner, a breastfeeding specialist who previously advocated for free birth, now realizes that this practice is not suitable for everyone.
paragraphs.zh: 官方資料顯示，全美居家生產的數量在2004年至2024年間幾乎增加了兩倍。一位名為梅利莎·切尼（Melissa Cheyney）的醫學人類學家兼前助產士指出，更多人在觀看網路宣傳後選擇了無醫療協助生產。同時，曾提倡無醫療協助生產的母乳哺育專家查爾斯·特納（Chale Turner）現在體認到，這種做法並不適合所有人。
